current_differences: Four-company corpus instead of Apple only.
Standalone Pinecone llama-text-embed-v2 computes semantic boundaries; integrated text-embedding-3-small computes retrieval embeddings for both strategies.
Source-preserving extraction is retained rather than regex-only document cleaning.
RAGAS uses Nebius Gemma as judge so no separate OpenAI key is required.
The four-way comparison adds fixed-size with reranking.
Reference semantic output is capped at 8000 characters; short HTML blocks and PDF page boundaries limit context.
retain_improvements: Preserve original documents and source fingerprints.
Keep numeric evidence, table years, units and citations.
Do not discard numeric-heavy chunks by alphabetic ratio.
Use development queries for tuning and held-out queries for evaluation.
Generate reports from actual saved runs; do not import reference scores.
Use versioned namespaces rather than automatic namespace deletion.
next_steps: Implement separate reference chunking profile with LangChain splitters.
Run both chunkers and validate source coverage.
Verify Pinecone schema/connection and upload both namespaces.
Add retrieval and FlashRank reranking with top10 to top3.
Add Nebius generation with source citations and abstention.
Build source-reviewed evaluation questions across companies/years.
Run four configurations and RAGAS plus numeric/citation checks.
